question:
Choose the correct one-word substitution for:
"A person who cannot make a mistake."
solution:
The correct answer is: **Infallible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Infallible"** refers to a person or thing that is incapable of making mistakes or being wrong. (अचूक)

 
 
• **Example:** The scientist was considered infallible in his field, as all his predictions were accurate.
 

 
• **"Infallible" **is often used to describe someone whose judgment or abilities are perfect and error-free. It emphasizes reliability and trustworthiness. (असंदिग्ध)

 
 
• **Example:** The infallible logic of the mathematician left no room for doubt.
 

 
• Hence, we can conclude that the correct one-word substitution for "a person who cannot make a mistake" is **"Infallible."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Infallible**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Invincible** (अजेय): Refers to someone or something that is too powerful to be defeated or overcome.
 
 
• **Example:** The team seemed invincible after winning every game of the tournament.
 
 

 
• **Irresistible** (अप्रतिरोध्य): Refers to something that is so attractive or tempting that it is impossible to resist.
 
 
• **Example:** The aroma of freshly baked cookies was simply irresistible.
 
 

 
• **Incredible** (अविश्वसनीय): Refers to something that is difficult to believe; extraordinary.
 
 
• **Example:** The magician performed an incredible trick that left the audience in awe.
